messages:
mina: Quick check  accessibility + microcopy for the Vectors Preview export flow. I mocked a compact preview with inline copy suggestions.
oz: The compact preview looks good. But the export action in row menu is confusing when multiple presets are active. Suggest: show current active preset name in the header and a small "(overrides row export)" tooltip.
kyle: For screen reader users, the active preset should be visible in the dialog title e.g., 'Download vectors  Compact CSV active'. Also include aria-describedby pointing to the short summary.
maria: Copy nit: for the breadcrumb in the modal use 'Workspace > Datasets > Vectors' not 'Home'.
sam: Accessibility: ensure that the preview toggle (Sample/Full) is a segmented control with role=tablist and each option role=tab. And remember to add aria-controls linking to the corresponding content panel.
mina: Edge behaviour: if user applies a preset and then sets a manual delimiter, we should show 'Custom' next to the preset name and highlight the changed field. Also add a note: 'This export uses custom settings; saving will create a new preset.'
noti-bot: Reminder: research task created - a11y-testing for export modal (ticket #UX-4123).
oz: Visual: reduce the emphasis on the vector blob area. Use mono font with a 'copy' button to copy the vector sample. Also add 'Copy example command' snippet for CLI download: `redwood export --dataset my-vectors --format csv --preset compact`.
kyle: For keyboard users, add a 'Preview row details' button that focuses the preview pane and opens inline details; ensure the row details are reachable from tab order.
mina: Good. Let's lock the copy for header/button labels: Header: 'Download vectors'; Primary: 'Download'; Secondary: 'Apply'; Overflow: 'Save as preset...'; Row menu: 'Download row (ignores preset)'.
noti-bot: Figma link: https://figma.com/file/xyz - preview-export-copy-v1 (updated 2026-03-23).
mina: Action items:
- Lock copy as above (mina)
- Implement ARIA roles for segmented control + listbox (kyle)
- Show active preset in modal title and header (oz)
- Mark custom settings when user edits fields post-apply (sam)
- Add CLI snippet and copy button in preview (oz)
mina: React with :white_check_mark: when done.
